text_devanagari: अहा॒ अरा॑ति॒मवि॑दः स्यो॒नमप्यभूर्भ॒द्रे सु॑कृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के। ए॒वाहं॰।॰॥७॥
notes: Segments stitched at a verified 1477 px offset (91 px overlap, zero pixel mismatch), then measured on the stitched line. The middle line's headline sits at y=131-145 and its glyph bodies end at y~230; below-line marks form an isolated band at y=234-252 separated by blank rows from both the line above's mark band (y=64-80) and the line below. All seven bars I report lie in the y=234-252 band, so they belong to this line, not the one above. Anudatta bars (global x-centres): 447 under हा of अहा; 796 under ति; 1219 under स्यो; 1627 under र्भ of भूर्भद्रे; 1855 under कृ (a separate component from the ऋ-descender hook directly above it); 2136 under लो; 2394 under ए of एवाहं. Svarita strokes (narrow, ~9-10 px wide, top y=92-104, clear white gap above, foot at the headline): x662-671 over रा; x994-1002 over वि; x1788-1797 over सु; x2040-2048 over स्य. Rejected false positive: a stroke at x1493-1499 that runs continuously from y=50 to the headline at y=144 (~95 px, no gap) and joins a ु/ू curl belonging to the line above — it is that mātrā's descender, not a svarita, so प्य is left unmarked. Two marks I first read at low magnification as anusvāras over रा and वि proved on magnification to be svarita strokes; no anusvāra is present in अरातिमविदः. The only anusvāra on this line is the round 18x18 dot at x2583-2600 on हं. The 1856 अ (ऋ-like) occurs at the start of अहा and अरातिमविदः. Verse numeral read as ७. No [?]: every akṣara was legible at this magnification.
